name: Hanani
bio: Hanani, Nehemiah's brother, came from Judah to Nehemiah at the palace in Susa with other men and reported that the Jewish remnant there lived in great trouble and disgrace, with Jerusalem's wall broken down and its gates burned by fire. His report moved Nehemiah to days of weeping, mourning, and prayer, setting in motion Nehemiah's mission to rebuild the city (Nehemiah 1:1-4). He is a different figure from Hanani the seer who rebuked King Asa. Once the wall was finished, Nehemiah placed Hanani in charge of Jerusalem's security together with Hananiah, ruler of the citadel (Nehemiah 7:1-2).
